drafts-zu-r2-01-001.text: Izimbali ze-jacaranda nazo zigibela ibhasi. Amathikithi azo athengwe ngumoya omncane.
drafts-zu-r2-01-001.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.

drafts-zu-r2-01-002.text: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zenza umsebenzi wazo.
drafts-zu-r2-01-002.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

drafts-zu-r2-01-003.text: Isibhakabhaka esiluhlaza esihle kakhulu ezweni lonke, kodwa kuzwakala sengathi usefrijini elinombukiso.
drafts-zu-r2-01-003.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.

drafts-zu-r2-01-004.text: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: indlu yotshani, umlilo, kuphelile.
drafts-zu-r2-01-004.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.

drafts-zu-r2-01-005.text: Ilanga lenza i-admin laphandle. Ukushisa bekungeyona ingxenye yephakethe.
drafts-zu-r2-01-005.en: The sun is doing admin out here. Heat was not part of the package.
